subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are delighted to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on June 15th. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number: AB1234 Departure time: 10:00 AM Arrival time: 3:00 PM Seat: 12A Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Airline Team
